description: Drive to the nearest confirmed semantic track of a person and stop at the default gap: gap_min(person) rounded up to 0.1 m, where gap_min = car_radius + obstacle_safety_margin_m + class margin + object_gap_settle_buffer_m (0.42 m, so 0.5 m at the current stack_params). No distance is hardcoded: the gap is measured from the car's front to the person's near edge and resolved at load. Needs semantic_layer_node (/costmap/semantic_tracks) and the global EKF.
